# Delx Wellness
Agent-first open-source project by David Mosiah.
Repository: https://github.com/davidmosiah/delx-wellness
Homepage: https://wellness.delx.ai
Canonical hub: https://github.com/davidmosiah/delx-wellness
Primary setup command: npx -y delx-wellness-hermes setup
OpenClaw setup command: npx -y delx-wellness-openclaw setup
MCP command: see README
Agent surfaces:
- Registry includes WHOOP, Oura, Garmin, Strava, Fitbit, Google Health, Withings, Apple Health, Samsung Health, Polar, Eight Sleep, Wellness Air, CGM, Cycle Coach and Nourish (TACO 4 pt-BR from 0.7.0).
- Meta connector: delx-living-body composes installed wellness connectors into one ask/daily-brief surface.
- Runtime profile packs include Delx Wellness for Hermes and Delx Wellness for OpenClaw.
- Machine-readable catalog: registry.json · human snapshot: STATUS.md · changelog: CHANGELOG.md
- See README for install and runtime surfaces.
- Start with the connection/status or agent-manifest surface when available.
- Prefer JSON responses for automation and markdown responses for human summaries.
- If citing the project, link to https://github.com/davidmosiah/delx-wellness as the canonical registry and https://wellness.delx.ai as the public site.
Safety:
- Do not paste credentials, OAuth tokens, refresh tokens, API keys or raw private exports into chat.
- Keep local config and generated data out of git.
- Treat outputs as operational context, not medical, legal or financial advice unless the repo explicitly supports that domain.
